why_annual.not_a_verified_claim: That finer frequencies are noisier was never measured: monthly and quarterly were not fetched, so it stays a standing warning rather than a finding. The one annual movement that was measured is also uncorroborated by an independent annual forest signal, recorded in artifacts/validation/dw_temporal_signal.json.

update_frequency_claim: Once a year for the land-cover and light layers, monthly for spending, annually for the register area. A single-year recompute of the geospatial panel measured 1212.8 and 1232.2 seconds; the whole multi-period fetch measured 2644.5 seconds; materialising one annual composite as an asset waited 3392.6 seconds of server-side work.
